question: Should `/v1/chat/completions` expose internal OpenClaw tool activity, or should `tool_calls` remain limited to caller-supplied client function tools?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally expose only client tools; changing that would alter a stable Gateway HTTP API and a sensitive telemetry boundary.

options.title: Keep Client-Tools Only
options.body: Maintain the current Chat Completions contract and direct internal tool observability to existing or future diagnostic/audit surfaces.

options.title: Design Opt-In Telemetry
options.body: Sponsor a redacted, scoped, default-off internal tool telemetry contract with docs and HTTP tests before implementation.

options.title: Reclassify As Provider Bug
options.body: Ask for a concrete qwen request/response trace first if the reporter meant caller-supplied client tools are not returned correctly.

recommendation.title: Keep Client-Tools Only
recommendation.body: Maintain the current Chat Completions contract and direct internal tool observability to existing or future diagnostic/audit surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses Gateway API shape and security exposure, and steipete has recent follow-up history around the client-tool protocol and adjacent maintainer review context.
